title: Data Exchange Definition export performance improvement
summary: Data Exchange Definition exports now use in-memory mapping with bulk saves and reuse FlowField calculations to significantly improve performance on large record sets, with no change to output format.
key_points: Eliminates per-row database writes by building field values in memory first, then transferring to the persisted table in one bulk pass
Reuses pre-aggregated FlowField values from the grouping buffer instead of recalculating per line
Throttles progress dialog updates based on row count to reduce UI overhead on large exports
quote: Eliminate per-row database writes and redundant work during export.
